part-4-advanced/A09-LRN/A09-LRN-01-hypot.ko: hypothesis class·learning algorithm과 population·empirical risk를 구분한다. ERM의 목적과 한계를 통해 loss·data distribution·class가 학습 estimand를 정하는 방식을 설명한다.
part-4-advanced/A09-LRN/A09-LRN-01-hypot.en: Distinguish hypothesis classes, learning algorithms, and population versus empirical risk. Examine ERM objectives and limitations to specify how loss, data distribution, and class define the learning estimand.

part-4-advanced/A09-LRN/A09-LRN-02-bias-.ko: pointwise squared prediction error를 bias squared·variance·noise로 분해한다. loss·sampling 가정을 확인하고 estimator bias·model misspecification과 seed·data-sampling 변동을 구분한다.
part-4-advanced/A09-LRN/A09-LRN-02-bias-.en: Decompose pointwise squared prediction error into squared bias, variance, and noise. Check loss and sampling assumptions and distinguish estimator bias, misspecification, and seed versus data-sampling variation.

part-4-advanced/A09-LRN/A09-LRN-03-gener.ko: expected·observed generalization gap과 finite test risk를 구분한다. data-dependent hypothesis·validation 재사용에 따른 편향을 검토하고 신뢰구간·paired 비교와 shift의 범위를 정한다.
part-4-advanced/A09-LRN/A09-LRN-03-gener.en: Distinguish expected and observed generalization gaps from finite-sample test risk. Examine data-dependent hypotheses and validation-reuse bias, then specify confidence intervals, paired comparisons, and distribution-shift limits.

part-4-advanced/A09-LRN/A09-LRN-04-vc-di.ko: 모든 binary label을 실현하는 shattering으로 VC dimension을 정의하고 threshold·interval 예를 계산한다. growth function·uniform convergence와 worst-case bound의 해석 범위를 연결한다.
part-4-advanced/A09-LRN/A09-LRN-04-vc-di.en: Define VC dimension through shattering all binary labelings and calculate threshold and interval examples. Connect growth functions with uniform convergence and examine the scope of worst-case bounds.

part-4-advanced/A09-LRN/A09-LRN-05-radem.ko: 주어진 sample에서 random sign을 맞추는 empirical Rademacher complexity를 계산한다. supremum·기댓값·norm constraint·input geometry를 구분하고 random-label control 실험과의 차이를 설명한다.
part-4-advanced/A09-LRN/A09-LRN-05-radem.en: Calculate empirical Rademacher complexity from random-sign fitting on a fixed sample. Distinguish suprema, expectations, norm constraints, and input geometry, and compare theoretical complexity with random-label controls.

part-4-advanced/A09-LRN/A09-LRN-06-pac-l.ko: PAC guarantee의 accuracy와 confidence를 나눠 읽고 realizable·agnostic setting을 비교한다. training sample 반복에 대한 확률과 sample complexity를 한 번의 경험적 정확도와 구분한다.
part-4-advanced/A09-LRN/A09-LRN-06-pac-l.en: Read PAC accuracy and confidence guarantees and compare realizable with agnostic settings. Distinguish probabilities over repeated training samples and sample-complexity bounds from one empirical accuracy result.

part-4-advanced/A09-LRN/A09-LRN-07-probe.ko: probe의 experimental unit·함수족과 row·prompt·template·concept·model split을 명시한다. nested selection·control을 설계하고 일반화된 복원 가능성을 기능적 사용과 구분한다.
part-4-advanced/A09-LRN/A09-LRN-07-probe.en: Specify probe experimental units, hypothesis classes, and row, prompt, template, concept, and model splits. Design nested selection and controls while distinguishing generalized recoverability from functional use.

part-4-advanced/A09-LRN/A09-LRN-08-capst.ko: probe capacity ladder와 nested 평가를 설계해 empirical gap·random-label control·complexity bound를 따로 보고한다. iid·shift·model 일반화와 결과에 맞는 recoverability 주장을 정리한다.
part-4-advanced/A09-LRN/A09-LRN-08-capst.en: Design probe capacity ladders and nested evaluation, reporting empirical gaps, random-label controls, and complexity bounds separately. Assess iid, shift, and model generalization and write evidence-matched recoverability claims.
